limitations: This is milestone 13 acceptance. My Knowledge currently copies the full database with explicit 256 MiB database, 64 MiB source and 10,000-file bounds; realistic 25-100 repository feasibility and bounded cohort strategy remain required in task 14/final installed acceptance.

First/repeat wall time has uncontrolled OS/SQLite caches; source-byte counts are logical completed literal file reads, not physical I/O, and estimated tokens use ceil(JSON bytes/4). The Lab does not claim real cold storage performance or equalized context envelopes.

The exploratory operator case was selected after initial Demo inspection and is not independent holdout evidence. The 25-repository hermetic fixture does not establish arbitrary private-estate readiness or authorize release.
